description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>Nebius Token Factory&nbsp;is looking for&nbsp;scientists who can turn frontier&nbsp;LLM and VLM&nbsp;inference bottlenecks into research&nbsp;questions, conduct&nbsp;rigorous experiments, and&nbsp;translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused&nbsp;research and optimization&nbsp;projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts&nbsp;that engineers can&nbsp;build on.</p> <p>Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Lead&nbsp;research projects in efficient LLM and VLM&nbsp;inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.</li> <li>Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT),&nbsp;distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.</li> <li>Build prototypes&nbsp;using&nbsp;PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks,&nbsp;and collaborate&nbsp;with MLEs and platform engineers to&nbsp;turn them into&nbsp;production components.</li> <li>Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.</li> <li>Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.</li> <li>Develop rigorous evaluations&nbsp;covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token.&nbsp;Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.</li> <li>Work&nbsp;with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to&nbsp;select research priorities with measurable production impact.</li> <li>Share results through&nbsp;internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source&nbsp;artifacts, and mentor&nbsp;engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system&nbsp;trade-offs.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>A&nbsp;PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied&nbsp;mathematics,&nbsp;or a closely related&nbsp;discipline.</li> <li>A strong&nbsp;publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.</li> <li>Strong Python and&nbsp;PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.</li> <li>Deep&nbsp;knowledge&nbsp;of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving&nbsp;trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong experimental design&nbsp;skills covering&nbsp;ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>First-author publications&nbsp;at venues such as&nbsp;NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or&nbsp;HPCA.</li> <li>Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.</li> <li>Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.</li> <li>Experience&nbsp;applying&nbsp;post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.</li> <li>Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks&nbsp;demonstrating contributions to&nbsp;efficient AI systems.</li> <li>Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.</li> </ul><div title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production. About the Role As co-founder and CTO, you will help shape the company as well as its technology. Working alongside the founder as an eye-level partner, you will turn the ambition into an architecture, a product and an engineering team capable of delivering it.a Your remit spans the efficiency engine, the platform beneath it and the people building both. You will lead our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, grow the team and establish the standards that guide its work. You have led engineering before, but stayed close to the code, and want to keep building as your responsibilities grow. Two things define the technical challenge here. Efficiency is the product itself, so routing, fine-tuning, caching, quantization and open-weight serving sit at the heart of the roadmap. Agentic engineering is also central to how we work. You will set the standard for using individual agents and entire agent fleets effectively, building the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to move quickly while retaining sound engineering judgement. There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with relentless intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and look for people who take initiative and see things through. You will have the scope to make consequential decisions early, and the responsibility to turn them into something that works. What you’ll do You will move between architecture, code and company building, setting the technical direction while building the team that delivers it. Lead the engineering team: guide our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, review their work and establish the engineering and operational standards, including on-call and incident response. Build the team: lead technical hiring and decide how engineering grows as the company develops. Set the technical direction: make the architectural calls, shape the roadmap and decide what we build ourselves and where we use existing tools and services. Develop the efficiency engine: bring together routing, semantic and prefix caching, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation, quantization and batching, with inference economics informing each decision. Own open-weight serving: choose and operate vLLM, SGLang or equivalent, including GPU capacity and European hosting, alongside closed providers through a single interface. Make quality measurable: build rigorous eval harnesses and the evidence needed to establish whether a cheaper route still meets the agreed standard. Build the platform underneath it: own the gateway API, provider layer, identity and tenancy, precise usage and cost accounting, secure storage of customer keys and European infrastructure as code, with GDPR and data residency requirements built in. Stay hands-on: write code and play an active part in designing and building the platform and cost-efficiency systems. Develop our agentic engineering setup, from harness design and benchmarking to the agent workflows that help the team ship. Represent the company technically: bring depth and clarity to customer pilots, enterprise security reviews and investor conversations. About You You have grown into engineering leadership without losing the instinct to build. When faced with a difficult problem, you explore what would make it possible and look for a workable path through it, weighing failure modes alongside unit economics. AI has changed how you work, and you have taken the time to understand where it helps, where it fails and how to use it well. We are looking for depth in five areas: Engineering leadership: you have been a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering or engineering lead, ideally in a startup. You have hired and led engineers, established standards and taken responsibility for both the architecture and what the team shipped. Backend and platform engineering: you bring deep experience in distributed systems, API design, streaming, Postgres, Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud operations, with a broad understanding of what makes a platform reliable and scalable. You have taken systems into production, operated them under significant load and worked through incidents yourself. LLM cost efficiency: you have reduced costs in a production system and can explain the numbers, the decisions behind them and the trade-offs involved. Your experience covers techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA, routing, caching, quantization, distillation and batching, grounded in an understanding of serving economics. Open-weight models in production: you have served, tuned, evaluated and operated open models under load, including the GPU and capacity decisions that come with them. Agentic engineering: you build on strong coding fundamentals, with practical experience running agent fleets and designing and benchmarking their harnesses. You can reason independently about the code they produce and take responsibility for its quality. You also bring a disciplined approach to LLM benchmarking: thoughtful eval design, statistical honesty and a willingness to reproduce results before relying on them. Fluent English is required; German is a plus. Nice to have A strong open-source record, particularly in AI infrastructure or inference, with real users. Experience with LiteLLM, NVIDIA NIM, TGI, llama.cpp or similar, and with self-hosted or air-gapped enterprise deployments. Experience with European cloud providers such as Scaleway, Hetzner or OVH. Experience working in startups tackling similar technical challenges. Why Join With the pre-seed round closed and the first steps already taken, you will join at a point where there is momentum to build on and considerable room to shape what comes next. You will build alongside the founder, choose and grow the engineering team, and receive co-founder equity in the business you help create. The architecture, efficiency engine, security model and engineering culture are all still yours to shape. The decisions you make now will become the foundations for everything that follows. We are entering a market where competitors have larger teams, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that technical depth, focused decisions and a small team that works well together give us a meaningful opportunity to compete. For the right person, that is an interesting challenge to take on, with substantial ownership over how we approach it. This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

His personal content brings together nutrition, sport and the experience of building a company. Role description You own the development and day-to-day production of Leon’s personal social channels. Your job is to turn his knowledge, experiences and point of view into content that feels recognisably his and gives people a reason to keep watching. You are his creative partner: finding the story in a conversation, asking the follow-up question and spotting moments worth capturing. You take content from idea to finished edit and publication, with regular access to Leon for conversations and filming. You're full of determination to hone content creation as a newer craft and start with a 100% internship or you're deeper into the game and work part-time or freelance (minimum 50%). What you’ll do Develop the channel direction, content pillars, recurring formats and publishing calendar with Leon. Interview him regularly to uncover stories, opinions, lessons and explanations grounded in his own experience. Write hooks, scripts and captions that preserve his voice and work naturally on camera. Plan and film direct-to-camera videos, interviews and behind-the-scenes content; accompany him at selected relevant activities and events. Edit finished short-form videos, including audio, subtitles and supporting visuals, and adapt material for the agreed platforms. Publish content, engage with the audience and use questions and performance data to improve future pieces. Coordinate specialist freelancers when needed and work with Leon and relevant reviewers to keep factual statements accurate. What you bring A portfolio of compelling social videos, ideally including personality-led content, interviews or a channel you have helped grow. Strong interviewing and storytelling instincts: you can help someone express a clear, interesting point of view. Confident filming and editing skills, including practical knowledge of lighting and sound. Strong short-form writing and an ability to capture someone else’s voice. The judgment to make health and nutrition topics accessible without overstating the evidence. Initiative, organisation and comfort working closely with a founder, both on set and in everyday situations. Fluent in English, with particularly strong writing skills. German is a plus. Availability to work full-time, on-site in Zurich or Berlin, with regular in-person filming with Leon. Experience in health, nutrition, sport or entrepreneurship is a plus. Experience handling sensitive or unpublished material thoughtfully is valuable. Why this role Work directly with Leon and get close to the industry. Leon grew up in a family business with more than 25 years of supplement experience and brings deep industry relationships. You’ll learn through the conversations, decisions and stories behind his work, with direct access to him for ideas and feedback. Learn how experienced founders build again. Alongside Leon, you’ll work with the Fortisana team, including Piran, who helped build KoRo into one of Germany’s leading food brands. You’ll see how they apply that experience to building a new company from the ground up. Shape a voice people want to follow. You’ll have the creative freedom to develop original formats, ask better questions and turn Leon’s knowledge and experiences into compelling stories. Your work will shape his personal brand as Fortisana pursues its ambition to become a major consumer brand. Develop quickly through real creative work. Build your interviewing, writing, filming and editing skills through regular production and close feedback. You’ll create a portfolio that shows both your craft and your ability to bring someone’s personality to life. How to apply Send three pieces of work you’re proud of and explain exactly what your part was: concept, interviewing, script, filming, editing or publishing. We’re particularly interested in examples where you brought out someone’s personality or turned a conversation into a strong story. Add your location, availability and a short profile or CV. description: Position Overview Our company is a science-driven global innovator in functional ingredients and nutraceuticals. Building on decades of B2B leadership, we are actively expanding our footprint by scaling our core ingredient business while simultaneously launching a new commercial unit focused on finished B2C supplement brands across Europe. We are seeking a highly entrepreneurial, sales-driven Business Development Manager. In this dual-impact role, you will be responsible for driving high-value B2B ingredient sales to industrial and contract manufacturing clients, while strategically building, launching, and scaling B2C supplement sales channels across online and offline retail in the DACH region and broader Europe. B2B Sales & Key Account Management (Ingredients & CMOs) Revenue Generation: Drive commercial growth and achieve ambitious targets for high-value nutritional, cosmetical, and functional food ingredients. Client Engagement: Identify, negotiate with, and secure long-term commercial relationships with B2B clients in the Food, Cosmetic, and Pharmaceutical sectors across Southern Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. CMO Partnerships: Partner directly with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and formulation developers to integrate proprietary ingredients into finished products. Account Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive annual business plans for strategic key accounts to maximize margin and market share. 2. B2C Market & Channel Development (Finished Supplements) Go-To-Market Execution: Lead the launch and commercialization strategy for the new B2C supplement portfolio in Germany and Europe. Multi-Channel Expansion: Identify, open, and scale key B2C distribution channels, including: E-Commerce: Amazon Marketplace, online pharmacies, and digital marketplaces. Retail & Drugstores: Key buyers and category managers at major chains (e.g., DM, Rossmann, Müller). Pharmacies: Wholesalers, pharmacy associations (Apothekenverbünde), and specialized health channels. DTC & Digital Brands: Direct-to-consumer partnerships and brand collaborations. Listings & Trade Terms: Negotiate product listings, pricing structures, shelf placement, and promotional terms across retail and online platforms. 3. Brand Launch, Marketing & Cross-Functional Alignment Market Positioning: Adapt product positioning, packaging, and marketing messaging specifically for the German/European regulatory and consumer environment. Campaign Coordination: Work closely with internal and external marketing teams to drive promotional campaigns, influencer marketing, and digital activations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the commercial link between R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, and Product Management to align scientific innovation with market requirements. Qualifications & Requirements Industry Experience: Minimum 5+ years of proven commercial success in B2B sales and/or business development within the supplements, functional food, or health ingredients sectors. Selling Experience in Germany: Proven track record of selling supplements/ingredients to Food, Cosmetic, and Pharmaceutical clients, as well as hands-on experience working with Contract Manufacturers (CMOs). B2C Retail & Network: Strong, established commercial network across German drugstores (DM, Rossmann), pharmacy networks, online marketplaces (Amazon), or health retailers. Educational Background: Scientific degree (B.Sc. / M.Sc.) in Food Technology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Biology, or a related field; strong ability to communicate complex science-led product benefits. Languages: Fluent in both German and English (written and spoken). Entrepreneurial Drive: Self-motivated, highly sales-driven mindset with the demonstrated ability to build new business channels from the ground up. Mobility: Comfortable working from a home office base in Germany, with a willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and trade events. title: Social Media Content Creator Intern
description: Über Fortisana Muskeln bedeuten Lebensqualität. Wir bauen die Marke, auf die unsere Eltern gewartet haben. Wir glauben, dass Muskeln das unterschätzte Fundament unserer Unabhängigkeit sind: die Kraft, morgen noch das zu tun, was uns heute wichtig ist. Unsere Mission ist es, das Thema Muskelerhalt generationsübergreifend ins Bewusstsein zu rücken. Unser erstes Produkt ist ein wissenschaftlich fundierter All-in-One-Drink mit essentiellen Aminosäuren, Kreatin, einem veganen Kollagen-Aufbau-Komplex und Elektrolyten. Leicht, erfrischend und einfach in den Alltag einzubauen. Die Rezeptur wurde gemeinsam mit dem Longevity-Forscher Professor David Church entwickelt. Hinter Fortisana stehen Leon, Piran und Max. Wir verbinden tief verwurzelte Erfahrung in der Supplementbranche mit dem Wissen aus dem Aufbau von KoRo (240m Jahresumsatz) und Leon's Familienunternehmen, das seit 25 Jahren Nahrungsergänzungsmittel produziert. Gemeinsam bauen wir eine Marke rund um Kraft, Unabhängigkeit und Lebensqualität. Deine Rolle Du gestaltest den organischen Social-Media-Auftritt von Fortisana — von der ersten Idee bis zum veröffentlichten Beitrag. Du beantwortest echte Kundenfragen, zeigst unser Produkt im Alltag und entwickelst Inhalte, die Menschen ansehen, speichern und teilen möchten. Dabei setzt du selbst um: Du entwickelst Konzepte, stehst hinter der Kamera und schneidest fertige Videos. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam, das dir Orientierung und regelmäßiges Feedback gibt. Wenn ein Projekt zusätzliche Expertise braucht, koordinierst du spezialisierte Freelancer. Deine Aufgaben Gemeinsam mit dem Gründerteam entwickelst du die inhaltliche Ausrichtung, wiederkehrende Formate und den Redaktionsplan für unsere organischen Social-Media-Kanäle. Du verbindest Trendformate und Fragen aus der Community mit Produktwissen und relevanter Forschung in Geschichten. Du planst und organisierst Drehs mit Gründern, Teammitgliedern, Kund:innen und weiteren Mitwirkenden. Du filmst und schneidest Kurzvideos: von Produktdemonstrationen und Erklärvideos bis zu Interviews und Einblicken hinter die Kulissen — inklusive Ton, Untertiteln und einfachen Grafiken. Du erstellst ergänzende Stories und Carousels und entwickelst einen wiedererkennbaren visuellen Stil mit. Du veröffentlichst Beiträge, trittst mit der Community in Austausch und machst aus wiederkehrenden Fragen neue Content-Ideen. Du wertest aus, was Menschen zum Weiterschauen, Reagieren und Klicken bewegt, und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse für die nächsten Inhalte. Was du mitbringst Praktische Erfahrung mit Social Content und Arbeitsproben, die zeigen, was du selbst umgesetzt hast — gerne auch für einen eigenen Kanal oder ein persönliches Projekt. Ein gutes Gespür für Geschichten: Du verstehst, warum Menschen beim Scrollen stehen bleiben und weiterschauen. Sicherheit beim Filmen und Schneiden sowie praktische Kenntnisse in Licht und Ton. Freude am Schreiben von Hooks, Skripten und Captions. Ein gutes Auge für Bildgestaltung, Typografie und einfache Social-Media-Layouts. Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich zu erklären und dabei inhaltlich präzise zu bleiben. Eigeninitiative und Organisationstalent, um Drehs, Feedback und Veröffentlichungen im Blick zu behalten. Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch, insbesondere ein sehr gutes schriftliches Ausdrucksvermögen auf Deutsch. Zeit für ein sechsmonatiges Vollzeitpraktikum vor Ort in Zürich oder Berlin. Erfahrung mit Ernährung, Gesundheit, Lifestyle oder E-Commerce ist ein Plus. Kenntnisse in Motion Graphics und Sounddesign sind ebenfalls ein Plus. Warum dieses Praktikum? Lerne von Gründern, die bereits große Marken aufgebaut haben. Piran hat KoRo zu einer der führenden Food-Marken Deutschlands mit aufgebaut. Leon und sein Familienunternehmen produzieren seit mehr als 25 Jahren Supplements. Du arbeitest direkt mit uns und erlebst, wie daraus Entscheidungen über Produkte, Marke und Wachstum entstehen. Bekomme echten kreativen Freiraum. Schlage ein Format vor, teste einen neuen Hook, plane einen Dreh und setze deine Idee um. Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bekommst direktes Feedback vom Gründerteam - und vom Markt. Learning by Doing. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung in Storytelling, Dreh, Schnitt und Community-Aufbau. Dabei entsteht ein Portfolio, das deine Handschrift trägt, und du lernst aus nächster Nähe, wie eine Konsumgütermarke aufgebaut wird. Schaffe dir eine Perspektive im Team. Nach einem erfolgreichen sechsmonatigen Praktikum besteht die Möglichkeit, in eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle bei Fortisana übernommen zu werden, mit Equity-Beteiligung. So bewirbst du dich Schick uns drei Arbeiten, auf die du stolz bist, und beschreibe genau, was dein Beitrag war: Idee, Skript, Dreh, Schnitt oder Veröffentlichung. Wenn vorhanden, ergänze Ergebnisse und was du daraus gelernt hast. Dazu reichen dein Standort, dein möglicher Starttermin und ein kurzes Profil oder Lebenslauf. The Onboarding Manager plays a critical role in executing tasks that support adoption and time-to-value, while capturing and sharing relevant customer feedback to improve internal processes, content, and product quality. Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Sales, Customer Success, Account Management, Product, and Engineering teams, as well as a proactive approach to achieving onboarding milestones and ensuring accountability. 

This role will largely focus on accounts that want to use Maltego for cybersecurity and CTI use cases. Domain expertise in this area is a firm requirement.


What to expect

Your key responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of onboarding projects/accounts, ensuring consistent delivery on time and with quality.
  • Conduct onboarding meetings, product demos, company presentations, workshops, and training sessions (1:1 and 1:many).
  • Partner with customers to understand their business processes, deployment goals, and requirements; provide product information and technical guidance to support those goals.
  • Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and milestones; track progress and proactively address any roadblocks.
  • Effectively manage all project communication, both internally and externally.
  • Educate and enable customers on product features and best practices, supporting onboarding to deliver fast time-to-value.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to identify and eliminate onboarding risks; coordinate resources to ensure resolution.
  • Address technical issues, troubleshoot problems, and work with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Support) to provide timely solutions.
  • Gather client feedback and insights to improve the onboarding process and recommend product enhancements.
  • Build strong, lasting relationships with clients, serving as the primary point of contact during onboarding.
  • Ensure smooth hand-offs with Sales and Customer Success.
  • Maintain product and domain expertise in Maltego, OSINT, and other relevant domains
  • Up to 50% travel required


Your profile in short

  • 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity or Cyber Threat Intelligence.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills to all levels on the customer side.
  • Strong analytical and goal-oriented mindset backed by project management skills.
  • Ability to de-escalate customer support requests and maintain a positive, goal-driven customer relationship.
  • Moderately technical, with the ability to configure SaaS solutions and provide recommendations.
  • Experience in customer onboarding, customer service, support, account management, or customer success (advantage).
  • Fluent in English (required), additional languages (German and Spanish as a priority) are an advantage.

Maltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations, coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up.   • Build scalable onboarding journeys that accelerate customer adoption and success.
  • Collaborate with talented and mission-driven teams across the business.
 At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

Based in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 2 days per week in the office

title: Simovative - Senior Sales Manager (w/m/d) – Österreich & Schweiz
description: Info: Gestalte mit uns die digitale Hochschulwelt von morgen. Seit über 20 Jahren entwickelt Simovative mit academyFIVE eines der führenden Campus-Management-Systeme Europas. Unter dem Dach des Berliner Private Equity-Fonds FLEX Capital erlebt Simovative derzeit eine dynamische Transformation hin zu Wachstum und Internationalisierung. Deine Aufgaben Marktverantwortung: Du verantwortest den Auf- und Ausbau unserer Märkte in Österreich und der Schweiz anhand klarer Vertriebs- und Wachstumsziele. B2B Sales: Du steuerst komplexe Sales-Zyklen (6–24 Monate) vom Erstkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Consultative Selling: Du analysierst Kundenbedürfnisse, überzeugst Entscheidungsträger (z. B. Leitungsebene, CIO, Präsidium etc.) und entwickelst passende Lösungspakete. Networking & Marktpräsenz: Du präsentierst unsere Software bei Interessenten, auf Konferenzen, Hochschulmessen und Branchenveranstaltungen und baust dein Netzwerk gezielt aus. Cross-functional Collaboration: Gemeinsam mit Marketing, Produktmanagement und Customer Success optimierst du Vertriebs- und After-Sales-Prozesse. Data-driven Sales: Du nutzt CRM-Systeme und KI-Tools, steuerst deinen Sales-Funnel datenbasiert und treibst das ARR-Wachstum voran. Dein Profil Mind. 5-8 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise im EdTech-, Public-Sector- oder ERP- oder Systemhaus-Umfeld. Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit komplexen Softwarelösungen und langen, beratungsintensiven Sales-Zyklen. Vertriebserfahrung in Österreich und der Schweiz sowie Kenntnisse der jeweiligen Märkte. Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Ausschreibungen und Vergabeverfahren, idealerweise im Softwareumfeld. Eloquentes, verbindliches Auftreten – du bewegst dich souverän zwischen CIO, Dekanat und IT-Leitung & kannst komplexe Softwarelösungen überzeugend und verständlich erklären. Analytisches Denken, Struktur und Begeisterung für Technologie & Bildung. Aktive Nutzung von KI-Tools im Vertriebsalltag. Teamfähigkeit, Empathie, Humor und ein feines Gespür für das richtige Timing. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse auf Konversationsniveau. Benefits Wachse mit uns: Wir wachsen stetig und bieten dir hervorragende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie ein attraktives Jahreszielgehalt aus Fixum und variablem Anteil. Startup-Spirit trifft auf Erfahrung: Wir sind seit vielen Jahren erfolgreich am Markt und haben uns trotzdem ein offenes, direktes Miteinander auf Augenhöhe bewahrt. Arbeite so, wie du am produktivsten bist: Ob Homeoffice oder unser Münchner Büro mit Dachterrasse und bester Anbindung – du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsort flexibel und entscheidest, wo du (am jeweiligen Tag) am besten Arbeiten kannst. Entwickle dich weiter: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung individuell – mit Weiterbildungen, Zertifizierungen, Fachkonferenzen und digitalen Lernangeboten. So kannst du dein Know-how ausbauen, neue Impulse einbringen und Verantwortung übernehmen. Gut versorgt: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit attraktivem Arbeitgeberzuschuss, EGYM Wellpass, Lunch-Benefit, JobRad, Sportevents sowie freie Getränke und Obst im Büro gehören zu unserem Angebot. Ein Team, das zusammenhält: Flache Hierarchien, echtes Miteinander und Raum für Austausch – im Arbeitsalltag genauso wie beim Kicker oder auf der Dachterrasse. Mehr als nur Arbeit: Ob Sommerfest, Oktoberfest oder Teamevents – auch gemeinsame Erlebnisse kommen bei uns nicht zu kurz. Sinn und Wirkung: Mit unserer Software gestalten wir die Bildung von morgen und übernehmen Verantwortung – auch über den Job hinaus, beispielsweise im Rahmen unserer Social Days. Über uns Wir entwickeln nicht einfach Software – wir gestalten die digitale Hochschule von morgen. Seit über 25 Jahren kennen wir die Anforderungen und Besonderheiten des Hochschulwesens. Dieses Wissen verbinden wir mit dem Mut zur Innovation und dem Anspruch, Lösungen zu entwickeln, die langfristig Bestand haben. Mit unserer Campus Management Software academyFIVE unterstützen wir bereits mehr als 70 Hochschulen dabei, administrative Komplexität zu reduzieren und ihre Prozesse zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen mit Gestaltungskraft: Menschen, die vorausdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und verbindlich umsetzen. Die ihre Perspektive einbringen und gemeinsam mit uns Lösungen schaffen, auf die sich Hochschulen verlassen können. Kontakt Join us! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Bereits in der Pitch- und Angebotsphase gestaltest du Scope und Leistungsversprechen aktiv mit. Beratung & Workshops: Du verantwortest Formate wie jährliche Kunden-Workshops und Reviews und berätst auf Basis der Zielsetzung, Budgets und internen Dynamiken deiner Kunden passgenau. Schnittstelle & Enablement: Du bildest die Brücke zwischen Kunden, Geschäftsführung und Fachteams (z. B. UX, Creative, Digital Marketing) und hilfst Projektmanager:innen, Kundensignale richtig zu deuten und in die operative Arbeit zu übersetzen. Risiko- & Eskalationsmanagement: Du erkennst kritische Kundensignale frühzeitig, klärst Eskalationen auf Entscheiderebene souverän und hältst den Projektteams den Rücken frei. Enger Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Du berichtest regelmäßig zu Status, NRR, Kundenqualität und relevanten KPIs und treibst im engen Austausch die Weiterentwicklung unseres Account-Management-Systems voran. Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management: Du baust ab Tag 1 Glaubwürdigkeit auf C-Level und Sponsorenebene auf und bewegst dich sicher auch in komplexen, konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen. Souveräne Moderation & Beratung: Erfahrung in Konzeption und Durchführung von Strategie-Workshops sowie in der zielgerichteten Moderation von Kundenterminen. Ausgeprägtes Business- & Finanzverständnis: Kennzahlen wie NRR, Margen, Pipeline-Ökonomie und Kundenrentabilität sind für dich vertrautes Handwerkszeug. Analytisches Gespür & Proaktivität: Du erkennst aus scheinbar kleinen Signalen – etwa veränderten Budgetfreigaben, neuen Ansprechpartnern oder verzögerten Rückmeldungen – frühzeitig Chancen oder Risiken und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte daraus ab. title: Principal Brand Designer (Spain or Portugal - based role)
description: About the Role At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint. Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation. You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences. What you'll own Define the future of OLX’s  Group's brand ecosystem Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint. Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising) Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets. Build scalable creative systems powered by AI You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently. Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand. You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation. Raise the creative standard across OLX Group As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across  product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives. You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose. Translate strategy into brand experiences You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences. You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value. Drive adoption and influence across the organisation Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced. You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards. You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making. Mentor and elevate the craft As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work. You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation. What we're looking for We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally. You create brands that people trust  Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time. You think in systems You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables. You bring strategy to life through Design  You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact. You're fluent in AI-enabled Design You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential. You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams. You influence without authority You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers. You bring depth of experience You'll likely have: 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills Why join OLX OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses. As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale. This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come. If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you. Hiring Process We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:   First Stage   Portfolio & Design Leadership   This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges. Second Stage   Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership   In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands. Third Stage   Executive Partnership & Business Impact   This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design. Problem-Solver: Du kannst kritisch denken, Ideen hinterfragen und Deine eigene Perspektive einbringen, wenn es um Strategie und Umsetzung geht. Du bist AI-Power-User und gehst neue Wege, um Deinen eigenen Arbeitsablauf zu automatisieren und deinen Output zu maximieren. Benefits 💥 Was wir bieten Werde zum Gründer : Mache den „Founder MBA“ - im Schnelldurchlauf nimmst du alle Aspekte der Gründerrolle ein: Sales, Product, Fundraising, Operations. High-Performing-Team: Arbeite mit einem ambitionierten, talentierten Team zusammen, das Wert auf Ergebnisse legt und Dich herausfordert, jeden Tag zu wachsen. Zudem erwarten Dich bei Interesse gemeinsame Game-Nights, gemeinsame Sporteinheiten wie Padel oder Beat81. description: About AIOS AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable. Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses: The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders. Our master plan: Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market. Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR. Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider. Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe. Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication. In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company. We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS Being a Web Designer at AIOS We’re building a world-class team. As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results. Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life. You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match. This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu , our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann , our CRO Lead. You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO ( Richie ). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends. This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :) Key responsibilities You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast. Strategic ownership : Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks. High-converting web design : Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time. Value propositions : Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land. Follow the scent : Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy. Figma to live : Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer. AI-powered design and build : Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand. Systems that scale : Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high. Ship fast : Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does. Need to have Experience : 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals. User psychology : A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision. Value propositions : Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land. Design to code : Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential. AI-native : At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further. Ownership : Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it. Speed : You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week. Craft : High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed. Nice to have CRO : Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests. Analytics : Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next. Product flows : Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints. Regulated markets : Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries. Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale. Multi-market : Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages. SEO and performance : Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed. Our cultural standards We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members: Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission. Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity. Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us. If we're average we fail : We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. Commitment to candor : That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations. A maniacal sense of urgency : We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win. Enduring frugality : We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud. Bulldozing barriers : The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve. Keep your head down : We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that. The power of focus : We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it. <aside> 🎯 "You just build a f\ *ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take." </aside> Compensation & Benefits You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this. Compensation : $75k-$150k/yr including equity Benefits The stuff below is cool as well. Healthcare : comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate). Remote : our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely. Personal development : budget for books, courses, coaching. Personal wellness : budget for gym, health apps. GLP-1s : free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s. Health coaching : free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy. Work coaching : free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm. Equipment : Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed. What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.   1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

<aside>
🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

</aside>

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

  • a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

Benefits & Compensation

  • A thorough onboarding process within a motivated team and a pleasant working environment

Deine Mission

Als Production Test Engineer gestaltest Du die technische Performance unserer Produktionstestsysteme für Flash- und SmartCard-Speicherprodukte aktiv mit. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Testsysteme in der Serienproduktion stabil und leistungsfähig laufen. Dabei verbindest Du Dein Know-how in Hardware, Elektronik und systemnaher Software, um Fehler ganzheitlich zu analysieren und nachhaltige Lösungen umzusetzen. Bei neuen oder skalierenden Testlösungen arbeitest Du eng mit R&D zusammen und sorgst für eine robuste Überführung in die Serie.


Spannende Aufgaben warten auf Dich

  • Du betreust und optimierst unsere Produktionstestsysteme mit Schwerpunkt auf Testhardware, Elektronik und systemnaher Software.

  • Du analysierst Testausfälle, Retest- und Yield-Themen, identifizierst technische Verlusttreiber und leitest nachhaltige Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab.

  • Du stellst die technische Performance bestehender Testsysteme über deren Lebenszyklus sicher und entwickelst diese bei veränderten Produktionsanforderungen gezielt weiter.

Dein Profil

raw.description:
What we offer

Your mission

This role owns the data foundation of our perception systems end-to-end — the layer that directly determines model performance in real-world environments. You'll set the technical direction for how we collect, curate, and continuously improve the datasets behind object detection, working as a senior technical partner to ML, perception, and robotics teams — turning raw, messy sensor data into reliable, production-grade systems at scale.

You will take full ownership of the ML data lifecycle — from architecture decisions on ingestion and pipelines, through labeling strategy and QA, to driving continuous, metrics-informed dataset improvement — and will be expected to bring judgment and prior experience to how this is done, not just execute a defined process.



What you'll do:

  • Architect and own scalable pipelines for ingesting, organizing, and preprocessing large volumes of time-series camera and multi-sensor data (RGB, IR, thermal, depth, IMU)
  • Drive the strategy behind our object detection datasets, ensuring quality, diversity, and statistical representativeness at scale
  • Design and operate active learning loops that connect model performance directly to data selection and improvement priorities
  • Own labeling workflows end-to-end — tooling decisions, QA methodology, consistency standards, and coordination of annotation efforts
  • Partner closely with AI Engineers to diagnose model weaknesses, bias, and drift, and translate findings into concrete dataset strategy
  • Plan and lead data collection campaigns (field recordings, drone/video capture) to close gaps with high-value real-world data
  • Build internal tools and dashboards that give the org visibility into dataset quality, distribution, and performance gaps


Your profile

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and data processing frameworks (Pandas, NumPy, vectorized operations, multiprocessing)
  • Proven track record building and owning ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale video and sensor datasets in production
  • Deep experience with data orchestration and lifecycle management for ML/computer vision workflows, including dataset versioning and reproducibility
  • Strong command of object detection pipelines (Detectron2, MMDetection, COCO format, bounding-box standards)
  • Demonstrated experience designing active learning, uncertainty sampling, or semi-supervised dataset workflows
  • Deep familiarity with data annotation platforms (CVAT, Label Studio) and building automated QA/consistency checks
  • Strong grasp of evaluation metrics for object detection (IoU, mAP, precision-recall curves, class-wise metrics)
  • Comfortable owning decisions around databases (SQL/NoSQL), file systems, and large-scale image, video, and sensor dataset management
  • Track record of working cross-functionally and influencing perception, deployment, robotics, and data infrastructure teams
  • Fluent in English; German and/or French are a plus


Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud storage and MLOps tools (AWS S3, MinIO, ClearML, MLFlow, Weights & Biases).
  • Familiarity with ROS / robotics data formats (bag files, TF trees, sensor_msgs), Docker, or embedded ML workflows.
  • Prior work with robotics, drones, or multi-sensor perception systems, including IR, LiDAR, radar, or audio datasets.


What else

  • Outside-the-box creativity with a blend of conceptual and systematic design thinking.
  • High intrinsic motivation, attention to detail, and strong problem-solving mindset.
  • Structured, methodical, and reliable execution, even under uncertainty.
  • Humble, collaborative, and mission-driven — values collective success over ego.
  • High ethical standards and disciplined work ethic.
  • Extra-curricular achievements, leadership, or unique projects are a plus.
  • NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required.


Why us?

Join us to shape the future of AI-driven defense!

raw.description:
About the Job

We build and operate large-scale web crawling and extraction systems that turn unstructured, dynamic websites into clean, structured and correct data. You'll own crawlers end-to-end: discovery, resilient fetching against real anti-bot defenses, and turning HTML/PDF into trustworthy structured output.


What you will do


  • Build and scale crawlers that handle dynamic, large-scale sites, and keep them running as those sites change and fight back.
  • Stay ahead of anti-bot measures: TLS/browser fingerprinting, proxies, session and rate-limit strategy, and change detection.
  • Turn raw HTML and PDF into clean, correct structured data (including LLM-assisted extraction), where silently wrong output is worse than a crash.
  • Design and operate pipelines for ingestion, deduplication, versioning and enrichment.
  • Ship and run containerized apps in the cloud, with CI/CD.
  • Shape our technical architecture and engineering culture.


Our Tech Stack

Python, Docker, GCP (Cloud Run jobs), Azure Blob Storage, MongoDB. Go services and a React frontend on the periphery. You don't need all of it on day one, but you do need to ramp up fast.


Your profile

  • 3+ years of professional software development (5+ for the senior track).
  • Strong Python: real production code, async.
  • Hands-on web scraping at scale, including firsthand experience with anti-bot defenses and the failure modes of large-scale collection.
  • A data-correctness mindset: you care that extracted data is right, not just that the job finished.
  • Docker, at least one major cloud (GCP, Azure or AWS), Git and comfort on the CLI.
  • A clear communicator who works well in a small, fast-moving team.

Nice to have:

  • LLM-assisted extraction or other work with LLMs, ML pipelines or data labeling workflows.
  • Go or Java/Spring Boot.
  • Frontend (React), or eagerness to pick it up.
  • Terraform, Kubernetes and modern DevOps tooling.


Why us?

  • A vibrant in-office culture in Munich, with the option to work from home up to 60% of the time.

raw.title: Associate/Contractor - Lead Fire Safety Consultant
raw.description:
Lead Fire Safety Consultant | Hybrid | London & Surrounding | Contractor | Competitive Day Rate

 

At Ark Workplace Risk, we empower our clients to confidently manage risk, compliance, and safety through a trusted partnership built on expert knowledge, innovative solutions, and proactive guidance and insight. 

About Ark Workplace Risk: 

  • Proven Expert Knowledge: With over 30 years of experience and a prestigious and diverse portfolio of around 200 UK clients, we provide workable solutions that align with our clients' organisational and business goals, as well as regulatory requirements.   
  • Industry-Leading Software: Our innovative tools streamline risk and compliance management, putting clients in control and enabling them to demonstrate accountability to stakeholders. 
  • Insight-Driven Solutions: As industry thought leaders, we provide actionable insights into emerging legislation, guidance, and industry trends, ensuring court-readiness for their business. 
  • Responsive Partnership: From every day, business-as-usual guidance to urgent, critical, complex, and contentious scenarios, we work in partnership with clients, becoming their trusted advisor and solution provider, whenever and wherever they need us most. 
 
We're looking for a Senior Fire Safety and Strategy Consultant who is passionate about fire safety and delivering the GOLD Standard in the built environment and enjoys working in a team of dedicated multi-skilled safety professionals.
 
Benefits
 
  • Excellent professional development opportunities including training bursary.
  • Working with our prestigious and diverse range of clients in the built environment, including residential and commercial.
  • Opportunity to work on fire strategies for high-rise residential and complex buildings as well as various other fire safety assignments e.g. fire safety management systems as well as a variety of complex fire safety problems to solve.

 

Duties

  • Undertake retrospective fire strategies, and complex Type 1,2,3,4 fire risk assessments in complex residential and commercial buildings.
  • Reviewing and creating building safety management systems. 
  • Undertake complex compartmentation surveys and make recommendations.
  • Develop a corporate fire safety management system across client portfolios.
  • Act as an internal source of expertise for the consultants.
  • Support clients with contentious matters including fire brigade interventions.
  • Implement fire safety advice and site management systems, audits and reviews.
  • Design fire management plans for existing buildings.
  • Create fire safety solutions across a range of sites (varying in complexity) within the built environment.
  • Work with colleagues across Ark to contribute to new projects and developments – we have an open culture and are always looking to share and expand on our knowledge!
  • Monitoring of External Wall/ facade to confirm remedial work is assured. 

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years experience working as a Fire Safety Consultant in the built environment.
  • Extensive experience in undertaking fire specialist work e.g. fire strategies, fire management plans, and complex fire risk assessments in high risk commercial and residential buildings.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and excellent report writing abilities to deliver client reports in accordance with a forensic and pragmatic approach.
  • Comprehensive understanding of current UK building regulations e.g. Approved Document B.
  • Working knowledge of relevant Approved Documents and relevant Standards including BS9991, BS9999, BS9997, PAS 9980 etc.
  • Ongoing dedication to your CPD.

 

Qualifications and Memberships

  • Recognised fire safety memberships e.g. GIFireE or MIFireE or MIFSM
  • EngTech ADVANTAGEOUS.
  • Ideally on Tier 3 IFSM, FRACS or IFE fire risk assessor register or operating at that level.
  • Fire safety/ fire engineering diploma (Level 4 working towards Level 5).

 

Job Specifics

  • We are offering a competitive package (subject to location, skills, experience and track record)
  • The majority of our work is around London. This role also has a national remit and you will be required to travel outside of London from time to time, so you must have the flexibility and willingness to travel as required.

 

ABOUT ARK WORKPLACE RISK

Ark is a market leader providing an innovative suite of; Professional Service Solutions, Outsourcing and future-proofed Software and Analytics to mid/major organisations in the UK. With over 500 global and premium brands trusting Ark to deliver smarter Risk, Compliance, Safety.

We are committed to Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (ED&I) for everyone. All applicants will be treated fairly and without prejudice. No one will receive less favourable treatment or be discriminated irrespective of the following protected characteristics: Age, disability, gender reassignment (and identity), marriage and civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity, race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origins), religion or belief, sex (formerly gender) and sexual orientation.
